summary: Keep the web integrator route serving during Devnet replacement and reconcile failed replacement against the published build identity.

replay.detail: No application data replay or rebuild.

schema.detail: No database or wire schema changes.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Deployment-only scripts require Devnet up --replace support. Application interfaces are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No running service is activated by this change. Once adopted, serving registrations use make-before-break replacement instead of unconditional teardown.

manual.detail: No released-product manual step. Deployment owners explicitly adopt the updated integrator revision.

recovery.detail: Devnet owns failed replacement recovery. The integrator restores the previous build pointer only when the published edge confirms that revision, and leaves held generations untouched for operator recovery.
